Exam Date & Time: 09-May-2025 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  Manipal Institute of Technology, Bengaluru  
  BTech VI Semester  
  End Semester Examination - April / May -2025  
  ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE [IT-4401]  
Marks: 50                                                                          Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
1)           While designing an AI tutor. Analyze how inductive and deductive reasoning can be  
  used to teach it to adapt to different student behaviors.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Evaluate the performance of informed search over uninformed search when solving  
  a constraint satisfaction problem like Sudoku.                                  (5)  
  
2)           Analyze how Alpha-Beta pruning improves efficiency in minimax trees for strategic  
  decision-making in games like Tic-Tac-Toe.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Given the two propositional logic expressions:  
  Expression 1:  
  (P∧(P→Q))  
  Expression 2:                                                                      (5)  
  (P∧Q)  
  Determine whether Expression 1 is logically equivalent to Expression 2.Use logical  
  equivalence laws to simplify Expression 1.  
  
3)           A banking expert system uses First Order Logic to verify loan eligibility. Explain  
  how systematic inferencing supports this.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Analyze the need for ontological engineering in medical diagnosis systems that must  
  adapt to different categories and defaults.                                         (5)  
  
4)           In the Wumpus World, use Bayes' Rule to infer the location of a pit. Show how full  
  joint distributions support this.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Analyze how semantic representation in Bayesian Networks affects the interpretation  
  of conditional dependencies.                                                        (5)  
  
5)           Assess the role of utility theory in AI decision-making under uncertainty.  
  (5)
